# freenotepad.app

> A free, private online notepad and memo app that runs entirely in the browser. No login required, no cloud storage, no tracking. Notes are saved to localStorage on the user's device.

## Key Facts
- 100% free, no ads, no premium tier
- No account or login required
- Notes stored locally in browser localStorage (never sent to any server)
- Works fully offline after first load (PWA with service worker)
- Rich text editing (bold, italic, headings, lists, code)
- Markdown mode with toggle
- Export as JSON (all notes) or Markdown (individual notes)
- Import with merge or replace options
- Dark mode with persistent preference
- 6 font choices (Lora, Playfair Display, Merriweather, EB Garamond, Inconsolata, DM Sans)
- Pin, search, drag-and-drop reorder notes
- Trash with 30-day retention
- Keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+B, Ctrl+I, Ctrl+N)
- Fully responsive, mobile-friendly
- Single HTML file, no external dependencies beyond Google Fonts
- Accessible (ARIA roles, keyboard navigation, screen reader announcements)
